# Paras Verma — Portfolio

This is the portfolio of Paras Verma, a fullstack developer and AI engineer based in India (IST).

## Summary
- Builds production-ready web and AI applications using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, and RAG.
- Primary stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, RAG.
- Availability: Available for freelance.

## Current Experience
- Software Engineer Intern at Jspark AI (Nov 2025 - Jun 2026)


## Skills
- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript
- **Backend**: FastAPI, Node.js, Python, SQLAlchemy, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, GCP, AWS
- **AI & Agents**: RAG, Qdrant, langChain, langGraph, Claude Code, Cursor
